name: @builderforce/knowledge-client
description: The ONE typed HTTP client for the knowledge API (PRD 38 §4.8): a KnowledgeStore and JudgementPort over /api/projects/:id/knowledge*, plus graph, scopes, search and analysis-snapshot calls. Every host (web, VS Code, Rovr, on-prem) injects its own authenticated fetch; this package holds no auth and no I/O of its own.
